courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 閘室節水池設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「閘室有效水量」與「射流動量與導流」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；閘室節水池設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective chamber water volume" and "Jet momentum and redirection" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Water-saving basins for lock chambers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統；閘室節水池設計則以沿閘室節水池水量能量與誤差收支檢查回用機制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces; Water-saving basins for lock chambers centres on examine lock-basin reuse through chamber water, energy and uncertainty balances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閘室有效水量」與「閘室升降水量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到閘室節水池設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「連通廊道瞬時流量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective chamber water volume” and “Chamber lift volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Water-saving basins for lock chambers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 船閘人字門安裝

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Effective chamber water volume" and "Jet momentum and redirection" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Miter-gate installation for navigation locks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統；船閘人字門安裝則以以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces; Miter-gate installation for navigation locks centres on understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閘室有效水量」與「雙側靜水荷載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到船閘人字門安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「熱伸縮與安裝基準」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Effective chamber water volume” and “Two-sided hydrostatic loading”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Miter-gate installation for navigation locks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal movement and installation reference", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
history.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
history.text: 大型船閘的改進不只在增加閘室尺寸，也包含灌排分布、瞬變與船舶控制的共同驗證。工兵團二〇〇六年船閘水理手冊提供研究與操作經驗的方法背景，二〇一八年廊道閥手冊再聚焦控制構件。巴拿馬官方紀錄二〇一六年六月九日進行新閘試航訓練，同月二十六日完成阿瓜克拉拉與科科利首航，顯示整合試驗在啟用前的重要位置。本課沒有重建真實閥門時程，也未把新閘滾動門稱作人字門；各式只解釋水量、能量、壓力和船舶受力的不同機制，全部數值皆合成。
history.textEn: Improving large locks involves filling distribution, transients and vessel control as well as chamber size. USACE’s2006 manual supplies research and operational-method context, while the2018 culvert-valve manual focuses on control components. Panama records training transits on9June2016 and inaugural passage through Agua Clara and Cocoli on26June, placing integrated trials before opening. This course does not reconstruct actual valve schedules or mislabel new-lock rolling gates as miter gates. Its equations distinguish volume, energy, pressure and vessel-force mechanisms using entirely synthetic values rather than measured operating settings.
